short.zh: Avaka 長在這裡，前三道工序在這裡做
short.en: Where Avaka grows and the first three steps happen

game.zh: 工序①②③、補種 Avaka、巡山。2 月封山，不能進入。
game.en: Steps ① ② ③, replanting Avaka, walking the forest. Closed in month 2.

body.zh: Avaka（馬尼拉蕉麻，Musa textilis）外型像香蕉樹，但較纖細，葉片較窄、較尖。纖維不是取自樹幹，而是一層層疊成假莖的葉鞘。
body.en: Avaka (Manila hemp, Musa textilis) looks like a banana plant but is more slender, with narrower, pointed leaves. The fibre comes from the leaf sheaths that layer into its pseudo-stem.

body.zh: 蘭嶼是 Avaka 自然分布的北界之一，種在家族照顧的林地裡。
body.en: Lanyu is one of the northern limits of its natural range; it grows in plots looked after by families.

body.zh: 地圖上把山林放在朗島部落後方的山坡，因為本研究主要在朗島部落蹲點。
body.en: On this map the plots sit on the slope behind Iraraley (朗島), where most of this project's fieldwork took place.

terms.zh: 馬尼拉蕉麻，本研究的核心植物
terms.en: Manila hemp, the plant at the centre of this project

short.zh: 曬乾、撚繩、填縫，船在這裡完成
short.en: Drying, twisting and caulking: the boat is finished here

game.zh: 工序④⑤⑥、為部落的船出力。所有玩家從這裡出發。
game.en: Steps ④ ⑤ ⑥ and helping build the village boat. Every player starts here.

body.zh: 地圖上把工作室放在朗島部落的海灘。朗島族人（本研究主要學習對象）在朗島示範處理纖維，本研究也跟著學習。
body.en: On this map the workshop is on the beach at Iraraley (朗島), where a community member, the project's main teacher, demonstrated fibre processing and the researchers learned alongside.

body.zh: 船身的紋樣是依文獻畫的通用紋樣示意：紅白黑三色的船眼（mata no tatala）、人形紋（taotao）與三角幾何邊紋，不代表任何特定家族的船。文獻也提到，達悟族要複製別人的圖樣，傳統上必須以物交換，否則視為盜用。
body.en: The hull markings are a generic illustration based on the literature: the red, white and black boat eye (mata no tatala), the human figure (taotao) and a triangle border. They do not represent any family's boat. The same source notes that copying another's design traditionally required an exchange of goods, otherwise it was theft.

short.zh: 比較快的兩條路：機器加工或工業樹脂
short.en: Two faster ways: machine-processed fibre or industrial resin

game.zh: 完成山林三道工序、帶 2 份材料，就能在這裡完工。9 月與 10 月不能在商店完工。
game.en: After the three forest steps, bring 2 materials to finish here. Not possible in months 9 and 10.

body.zh: 機器加工天然纖維：船仍然用 Avaka，可以拆、可以修，但少了手工曝曬與撚繩的經驗。
body.en: Machine-processed natural fibre: the boat still uses Avaka and can be taken apart and repaired, but without the experience of drying and twisting by hand.

body.zh: 工業樹脂：很快完工，但接縫黏死，壞了無法拆修。朗島族人說，拼板舟的修造「現在都用南寶樹酯了」。
body.en: Industrial resin: finished quickly, but the seams are glued shut. An Iraraley community member noted that plank boats are now repaired with commercial resin.

body.zh: 商店的位置是示意，不代表真的商店。
body.en: The shop's position is illustrative, not a real shop.

game.zh: 3 AP（森林老化時 4）。得 1 份材料，1 月與 7 月得 2 份；同一個月可以重複做。
game.en: 3 AP (4 when the forest has aged). 1 material, 2 in months 1 and 7; can repeat in a month.

body.zh: 在開花之前，從近地面處砍斷假莖、剝下葉鞘。開花後纖維品質會下降。
body.en: Before it flowers, the pseudo-stem is cut near the ground and the sheaths peeled off. After flowering the fibre is poorer.

terms.zh: avaka 的採集法（砍斷剝皮、掛在樹枝上摩擦、劃痕撕絲、掛竿曬乾）
terms.en: the avaka harvesting method (cut and peel, rub over a branch, score and tear, hang to dry)

caption.zh: 朗島族人把 Nyaga 的假莖剝成一層層葉鞘（朗島）。照片中的植物是 Nyaga，不是 Avaka。
caption.en: An Iraraley community member peels a Nyaga pseudo-stem into sheaths (Iraraley). The plant shown is Nyaga, not Avaka.

game.zh: 3 AP，需要 1 份材料。
game.en: 3 AP, needs 1 material.

body.zh: 把葉鞘掛在樹枝或樹幹上，抓住兩端來回拉動摩擦，讓它變軟。
body.en: The sheath is hung over a branch or trunk and pulled back and forth by both ends until it softens.

body.zh: 這一步沒有田野影像。研究者在田野中沒能親眼看到 Avaka 的傳統取纖工序，正確的做法只能透過朗島耆老的口述得知。
body.en: There is no field footage of this step. The researchers never saw the traditional Avaka process first-hand; it is known only from the accounts of Iraraley elders.

game.zh: 3 AP，需要 1 份材料。
game.en: 3 AP, needs 1 material.

body.zh: 以小刀在葉鞘內側劃開，把纖維一絲絲撕出。
body.en: A small knife scores the inside of the sheath and the fibre is torn out strand by strand.

body.zh: 田野中看到的 Nyaga 做法是刮除肉質層，和文獻記載的 Avaka 做法（劃痕後撕絲）不同。
body.en: In the field, Nyaga was processed by scraping off the flesh, unlike the scoring and tearing recorded for Avaka.

terms.zh: 撕絲前在葉鞘內側劃痕用的小刀
terms.en: the small knife used to score the sheath

caption.zh: 朗島族人刮除 Nyaga 葉鞘的肉質層（朗島）。照片中的植物是 Nyaga，不是 Avaka。
caption.en: An Iraraley community member scrapes the flesh from a Nyaga sheath (Iraraley). The plant shown is Nyaga, not Avaka.

game.zh: 3 AP，需要 1 份材料。5 月梅雨前沒做完，材料可能泡壞。
game.en: 3 AP, needs 1 material. Not done before the May rains, the material may spoil.

body.zh: 撕下的纖維帶回來掛在竿子上曬乾。潮濕會腐爛，曬得太乾又會變脆，不好撚。
body.en: The fibre is brought back and hung on poles to dry. Damp fibre rots; fibre dried too far turns brittle and hard to twist.

caption.zh: Nyaga 纖維掛起來曬乾（朗島）。照片中的植物是 Nyaga，不是 Avaka。
caption.en: Nyaga fibre hung up to dry (Iraraley). The plant shown is Nyaga, not Avaka.

game.zh: 3 AP（12 月 0 AP），需要 1 份材料與 KP 3。
game.en: 3 AP (0 in month 12), needs 1 material and KP 3.

body.zh: 把曬乾的纖維理順，兩股互相搓撚成繩，撚的方向不能錯。
body.en: The dried fibre is combed straight and two strands are twisted against each other into cord, always in the right direction.

caption.zh: 以 Nyaga 纖維撚成的繩。照片中的纖維是 Nyaga，不是 Avaka。
caption.en: Cord twisted from Nyaga fibre. The fibre shown is Nyaga, not Avaka.

game.zh: 3 AP（耆老 0 AP），需要 1 份材料與 KP 8。完工 +20 分。10 月不能做。
game.en: 3 AP (0 for the elder), needs 1 material and KP 8. +20 points. Not in month 10.

body.zh: 接合船板時，以蘭嶼花椒（varok）根部的棉絮填塞船板接縫，讓船不漏水。
body.en: When the planks are joined, the seams are packed with floss from the roots of varok (Lanyu prickly ash) so the boat does not leak.

body.zh: 這一步沒有田野影像。
body.en: There is no field footage of this step.

terms.zh: 以 varok 根部棉絮填塞船板接縫（原文拼作 varuk）
terms.en: packing plank seams with varok root floss (spelled varuk in the source)

terms.zh: 蘭嶼花椒，根部纖維用於拼板舟填縫
terms.en: Lanyu prickly ash; its root fibre caulks plank boats

facts.zh: 本研究主要的田野地點，2026 年 1 月到 9 月共去了五次。
facts.en: The project's main field site, visited five times from January to September 2026.

facts.zh: 朗島族人（本研究主要學習對象）在這裡示範處理纖維；Avaka 的傳統做法，來自朗島耆老的口述與文獻相互印證。
facts.en: A community member, the project's main teacher, demonstrated fibre processing here; the traditional Avaka method comes from the account of an Iraraley elder checked against the literature.

facts.zh: 1966 年政府拆除傳統家屋、改建國宅時，朗島和野銀的國宅另建在村落附近，傳統家屋因此保留下來；不過 1994 年起的改建計畫後，朗島舊聚落的傳統家屋大多改成了水泥房屋。
facts.en: When traditional houses were demolished for state housing from 1966, Iraraley's and Ivalino's new houses were built beside the old villages, so their traditional houses survived; after the rebuilding plan of 1994 most of Iraraley's old houses became concrete.

facts.zh: 目前判斷最有可能是 Avaka 的植株，在東清耆老的田區。
facts.en: The plants judged most likely to be Avaka grow in the field of an Iranmeylek elder here.

facts.zh: 東清部落的報導人說，現在會處理 Avaka 的人「全鄉幾乎都沒有，大概在我們東清才有兩三個」。
facts.en: An Iranmeylek interviewee said hardly anyone on the island still processes Avaka, perhaps two or three people in Iranmeylek.

facts.zh: 東清的耆老說，在 Kapowan（夜曆 2 月）東清會燒山，把乾的蘆葦莖割下來做捕飛魚的火把。
facts.en: An Iranmeylek elder recalls that in Kapowan the hillside reeds are burned and the dry stems cut for flying-fish torches.

facts.zh: 野銀的傳統家屋是保存最完整的雅美（達悟）族傳統建築聚落，2002 年由臺東縣政府登錄為歷史建築。
facts.en: Ivalino has the most complete surviving village of traditional Tao houses, registered as a historic building by Taitung County in 2002.

facts.zh: 傳統家屋依山面海，在緩坡上挖深約 1–2 公尺做主屋和工作房的地基；一戶通常有主屋、工作房、涼台，還有前庭、靠背石、曬魚架。外人常叫它「地下屋」，其實是深穴式建築。
facts.en: Houses face the sea with their backs to the hill, set into pits 1–2 m deep on the slope: a main house, a workhouse and a raised platform, with a forecourt, backrest stones and fish racks. Outsiders call them 'underground houses', but they are deep-pit houses.

facts.zh: 紅頭部落的耆老說，紅頭在 Paneneb 月的初二就開始舉行招魚祭，並說飛魚的文化是紅頭的祖先創造的。
facts.en: An Imaorod elder recalls that Imaorod begins its flying-fish calling rite on the second day of Paneneb, and says the flying-fish culture began with Imaorod's ancestors.

facts.zh: 紅頭村的蘭嶼氣象站建於 1940 年，是蘭嶼唯一僅存的日治時期建築，2005 年登錄為歷史建築。
facts.en: The Lanyu weather station in Hongtou village, built in 1940, is the island's only surviving building from the Japanese era; it was registered as a historic building in 2005.

short.zh: 判斷最有可能是 Avaka 的植株
short.en: Plants judged most likely to be Avaka

body.zh: 目前判斷最有可能是 Avaka 的植株，在東清耆老的田區；這位耆老確信它是 Avaka。本研究收集的 Avaka 纖維，只有取自這塊田、曬乾的纖維。
body.en: The plants judged most likely to be Avaka grow in an Iranmeylek (東清) elder's field; the elder is sure they are Avaka. The only Avaka fibre the project collected came from here.

body.zh: 這裡的植株要開花結果才能確認物種，可能需要一年以上。地圖上的位置是示意。
body.en: Confirming the species needs the plants to flower and fruit, which may take more than a year. The position on this map is illustrative.

short.zh: 紅頭村山頂，蘭嶼唯一僅存的日治時期建築
short.en: On the hilltop in Hongtou village; the island's only surviving Japanese-era building

body.zh: 位於蘭嶼中央的山頂，海拔 324 公尺，天晴時可以看見鵝鑾鼻燈塔和菲律賓的巴士群島。
body.en: On a hilltop in the middle of the island, 324 m up; on clear days the Eluanbi lighthouse and the Batanes can be seen.

body.zh: 1940 年由臺灣總督府強行徵調雅美（達悟）族人修建，翌年完工；戰時曾遭轟炸，牆上仍留有彈孔。
body.en: Built in 1940 with Tao labour forcibly conscripted by the colonial government and finished the next year; it was bombed in the war and bullet holes remain in the walls.

body.zh: 是蘭嶼唯一僅存的日治時期建築，2005 年由臺東縣政府登錄為歷史建築。地圖上的模型是示意。
body.en: It is Lanyu's only surviving Japanese-era building, registered as a historic building by Taitung County in 2005. The model on the map is illustrative.

body.zh: 原住民族委員會的部落位置資料，以蘭嶼航空站作為漁人部落的定位點。
body.en: The Council of Indigenous Peoples uses Lanyu Airport as the reference point for Iratay.

body.zh: 跑道與航廈的位置依 OpenStreetMap；模型與飛機是示意。
body.en: Runway and terminal positions from OpenStreetMap; the models and the plane are illustrative.

position.zh: 族語名稱與位置依原住民族委員會公告的部落位置資料（定位點：{pt}）
position.en: Tao name and position from the Council of Indigenous Peoples community data (reference point: {pt})

hint.zh: 拖曳旋轉・滾輪或雙指縮放・點地名看說明
hint.en: Drag to turn · scroll or pinch to zoom · tap a name

failed.zh: 島嶼載入失敗，請重新整理頁面。
failed.en: The island could not load. Please refresh the page.

canvas.zh: 3D 蘭嶼島，可以拖曳旋轉；完整文字內容請用左邊的清單
canvas.en: 3D island of Lanyu. Drag to turn; the list has all the text.

monthNote.zh: 天色是每個月的示意，不是氣象紀錄。
monthNote.en: The sky is a mood for each month, not a weather record.

body.zh: 拖曳可以旋轉，滾輪或雙指可以縮放。海岸線、山頭與六個部落的位置，都照真實的蘭嶼。
body.en: Drag to turn, scroll or pinch to zoom. The coastline, the peaks and the six villages follow the real Lanyu.

body.zh: 點地圖上的地名或左邊的清單，鏡頭會飛過去並打開說明卡。卡片有族語、田野照片和出處。
body.en: Tap a name on the map or in the list: the camera flies there and a card opens, with Tao words, field photos and sources.

body.zh: 下方的月份軸可以切換十二個月，按「播放一年」，看文化復振青年一個月一個月做完六道工序。
body.en: The month bar at the bottom switches between the twelve months. Press 'Play the year' to follow the youth through the six steps, month by month.

body.zh: 按工具列的「Avaka 的一生」，鏡頭會帶你走五站，每站對應這份研究的一個問題。每段文字都標出它來自田野觀察、口述、文獻，還是推論。
body.en: Press 'Avaka's life' in the toolbar and the camera takes you through five stops, each tied to one of this study's questions. Every paragraph is tagged as field observation, oral account, literature or inference.

evLegend.zh: 標籤說明每段文字從哪裡來。研究者是漢人，提問來自外部視角，詮釋可能有偏誤。
evLegend.en: Tags show where each paragraph comes from. The researcher is Han Taiwanese and asks from an outside view, so the reading may be biased.

unconfirmed.en: Inference, not yet confirmed by flowering

monthMoved.zh: 地圖切到 3 月：曬魚架上才有飛魚。
monthMoved.en: The map has moved to month 3, when fish hang on the racks.

game.zh: ①砍伐剝皮獲得 2 份材料。
game.en: ① Cut and peel yields 2 materials instead of 1.

note.zh: 照最快的進度，這個月做①砍伐剝皮。
note.en: On the fastest schedule, this month is for ① cut and peel.

calendar.zh: 舉行立春儀式與孝敬父母日；殺豬祈求出海平安。準備捕魚工具、修補大船。東清的耆老也提到，這個月的祈福儀式會用到絲芭蕉（avaka）和蘆葦。
calendar.en: The spring rite and a day honouring parents; a pig is offered for safe fishing. Fishing gear is readied and the big boats repaired. An Iranmeylek elder adds that the month's blessing uses avaka and reeds.

game.zh: 不能進入山林；月初還在山林的人會被移回灘頭工作室。這個月無法做任何工序。
game.en: The forest is closed; anyone still there is sent back to the beach workshop. No craft step can be done this month.

note.en: The forest is closed; staying at the beach workshop.

calendar.zh: 舉行招飛魚祭，開始夜間火把捕魚；上山砍曬魚架的材料。Paneneb 是「關起」的意思，天冷閉戶，是禁忌最多的月份。
calendar.en: The flying-fish calling rite; night fishing by torchlight begins, and wood is cut for drying racks. Paneneb means 'closed': a cold month of shut doors and the most taboos.

game.zh: 所有工序少 1 AP。
game.en: Every craft step costs 1 AP less.

note.zh: 照最快的進度，這個月做②懸掛摩擦軟化。
note.en: On the fastest schedule, this month is for ② hang and rub.

calendar.zh: 全力捕撈飛魚，飛魚可帶回家塗鹽晾曬；婦女上山採集陸蟹。kaod 是「划（出漁）」的意思。
calendar.en: Full flying-fish season; fish are salted and dried at home, and women gather land crabs. kaod means 'to paddle out'.

game.zh: 所有請益多 1 AP。部落記事會預告下個月的梅雨。
game.en: Every Ask costs 1 AP more. The village log warns of next month's plum rain.

note.zh: 照最快的進度，這個月做③劃痕撕絲。
note.en: On the fastest schedule, this month is for ③ score and tear.

calendar.zh: 小船招魚祭，開始白天釣鬼頭刀；舉行慰勞節，婦女做芋頭糕慰勞丈夫。
calendar.en: The small-boat calling rite and daytime fishing for mahi-mahi; at the thanksgiving feast women make taro cakes for their husbands.

game.zh: 進入本月時，持有材料且未完成④的人，用 4 月剩下的 1 AP 防潮；4 月把 AP 用光的人，材料全部歸零。
game.en: On entering this month, players holding materials who have not finished ④ spend 1 AP left from month 4 to keep them dry; anyone who used all their AP loses their materials.

note.zh: 照最快的進度，這個月做④脫水曝曬乾燥。
note.en: On the fastest schedule, this month is for ④ dry.

calendar.zh: 月初祈福祭；蒸飛魚、儲存飛魚乾；製作木臼與木杵。
calendar.en: A blessing at the start of the month; flying fish are steamed and stored dry; mortars and pestles are made.

game.zh: 送禮給耆老、幫忙長者的得分加倍（各 +2 分）。
game.en: Gifts to the elder and helping the elder score double (+2 each).

note.zh: 照最快的進度，這個月做⑤理線撚繩。
note.en: On the fastest schedule, this month is for ⑤ comb and twist.

calendar.zh: 「好月節」：親友互相贈送飛魚、分享勞動成果；捕飛魚到本月結束。
calendar.en: The 'good month': relatives give each other flying fish and share the year's work; flying-fish catching ends this month.

game.zh: ①砍伐剝皮獲得 2 份材料。
game.en: ① Cut and peel yields 2 materials instead of 1.

note.zh: 照最快的進度，這個月做⑥填縫完工。
note.en: On the fastest schedule, this month is for ⑥ caulk and finish.

calendar.zh: 開墾新的水芋田與地瓜田；適合主屋、涼台與拼板舟的落成禮。
calendar.en: New taro and sweet-potato fields are opened; a good month for launching houses, platforms and plank boats.

game.zh: 科學轉譯必定成功。
game.en: Scientific translation always succeeds.

note.zh: 自己的船完工後，繼續為部落的船出力。
note.en: With their own boat finished, helping build the village boat.

calendar.zh: 採陶土、燒陶甕（tana 是泥土）。
calendar.en: Clay is dug and pots are fired (tana means earth).

game.zh: 不能在商店完工。
game.en: You cannot finish at the shop this month.

note.zh: 自己的船完工後，繼續為部落的船出力。
note.en: With their own boat finished, helping build the village boat.

calendar.zh: 月中舉行飛魚終食祭，之後不再吃、也不再儲存飛魚乾。
calendar.en: Mid-month the flying-fish ending rite; after it no dried flying fish is eaten or kept.

game.zh: 任何方式都不能完工（填縫、機器加工、工業樹脂）。
game.en: No boat may be finished by any path (caulking, machine processing or resin).

note.zh: 自己的船完工後，繼續為部落的船出力。
note.en: With their own boat finished, helping build the village boat.

calendar.zh: 全年最不吉利的月份，不建屋、不讓船落成、不為嬰兒取名；專門燒製貝灰（也是彩繪船身的白色原料）。
calendar.en: The least auspicious month: no house or boat is completed and no baby named. Shells are burned for lime, also the white used to paint boats.

game.zh: 月初與耆老同地點的文化復振青年、中生代各 +2 KP。
game.en: At the start of the month, the youth and middle generation in the same place as the elder gain +2 KP each.

note.zh: 自己的船完工後，繼續為部落的船出力。
note.en: With their own boat finished, helping build the village boat.

calendar.zh: 祭拜天神與祖靈（Pazos）；播種小米；採伐蘆葦準備做火把。
calendar.en: Offerings to the heavens and the ancestors (Pazos); millet is sown; reeds are cut for future torches.

game.zh: ⑤理線撚繩 0 AP；⑤與⑥不必跨月等待，可以同月接連完成。
game.en: ⑤ Comb and twist costs 0 AP, and ⑤ and ⑥ can be done back to back this month.

note.zh: 自己的船完工後，繼續為部落的船出力。
note.en: With their own boat finished, helping build the village boat.

extra.zh: 在夜曆中，Kaowan（約陽曆 12–1 月）是紡織及手工之月。
extra.en: In the night calendar, Kaowan (about December–January) is the month of weaving and handicraft.

calendar.zh: 男人冶鐵、製作槳繩；女人織布、編藤籃；婦女祝福芋頭田。
calendar.en: Men forge metal and make paddle ropes; women weave cloth and rattan baskets and bless the taro fields.

paras.zh: Avaka（馬尼拉蕉麻，Musa textilis）原產菲律賓，不是蘭嶼本來就有的植物。蘭嶼和巴丹群島的語言同屬 Batanic 語群，兩地也都留有用芭蕉屬纖維打結、編結的工藝。
paras.en: Avaka (Manila hemp, Musa textilis) is native to the Philippines, not to Lanyu. The languages of Lanyu and the Batanes Islands both belong to the Batanic group, and both places keep a craft of knotting and tying banana-family fibre.

ref.en: Handbook, "I thought it would be easy to find"

paras.zh: 兩地的往來，約在三百年前因不明原因中斷。
paras.en: Contact between the two broke off, for unknown reasons, about three hundred years ago.

paras.zh: 命名、技術、考古三類線索只能互相參照，不足以重建 Avaka 的傳入史。它是不是跟著祖先渡海而來，目前還沒有證據能回答。
paras.en: Names, techniques and archaeology can only be read against each other; together they are not enough to reconstruct how Avaka arrived. Whether it crossed the sea with the ancestors cannot yet be answered.

paras.zh: 從蘭嶼氣象站所在的山頂，天晴時看得見菲律賓的巴士群島。
paras.en: From the hilltop of the Lanyu weather station, the Bashi (Batanes) Islands of the Philippines can be seen on clear days.

paras.zh: 依文獻與耆老口述相互印證，Avaka 的工序重建為六道：在山林砍伐剝皮、懸掛摩擦、劃痕撕絲，再到灘頭曝曬、撚線、填縫。
paras.en: Read against the literature and an elder's account, Avaka's work is reconstructed as six steps: felling and stripping, rubbing and softening, scoring and tearing in the forest, then drying, twisting and caulking at the beach.

paras.zh: 研究者在五次田野中沒能親眼看到 Avaka 的傳統取纖。田野裡還有人動手做的，是朗島族人在 Nyaga 上摸索出的做法：刮除肉質層，而不是劃痕後順著纖維撕絲。
paras.en: In five field trips the researcher never saw Avaka fibre taken the traditional way. What people still do by hand is a method an Iraraley community member worked out on Nyaga: scraping off the flesh rather than scoring the sheath and tearing along the fibre.

paras.zh: 「那是我的打法，那個不是蘭嶼的打法，那是我從網路抓的打法，因為沒有人教我。」——朗島族人談接線
paras.en: "That's my way of tying it, not the Lanyu way. I got it off the internet, because nobody taught me." — an Iraraley community member, on joining fibre

ref.zh: 手冊〈記憶裡的做法，手上的做法〉

paras.zh: 招魚祭時，捕到的飛魚沾上雞血，再用 Avaka 綁吊起來；小船祭的準備清單把 Avaka 列為首要的祈禱物件，用作釣鬼頭刀和飛魚的吊繩。
paras.en: At the fish-calling rite, caught flying fish were dabbed with chicken blood and hung up with Avaka; the preparation list for the small-boat rite puts Avaka first among the prayer items, as the hanging cord for dorado and flying fish.

paras.zh: 朗島部落的報導人說，「一開始飛魚季它是用avaka去綁」，之後飛魚變多才改用林投的氣根；飛魚季有分階段，「前面那兩個月規矩最嚴謹」。
paras.en: An Iraraley interviewee said that at the start of the flying-fish season the fish were tied with avaka, and only later, when the catch grew, with pandanus aerial roots; the season has stages, and the rules are strictest in the first two months.

paras.zh: 本研究據此認為，Avaka 在儀式中是連結人與魚、祈求漁獲的媒介，意義不止於繩材。
paras.en: From this, the study reads Avaka in ritual as a medium linking people and fish and asking for a catch, more than a cord.

paras.zh: 1975 年後化學樹脂進入蘭嶼，很快取代了用 Avaka 壓實蘭嶼花椒的填縫。
paras.en: After 1975 chemical resin reached Lanyu and quickly replaced caulking with Avaka pressed over Lanyu prickly-ash fibre.

paras.zh: 化學膠讓船板難以拆開修補，船從「可循環維修的有機體」變成「一次性消耗品」；族人也不再需要為造舟撫育 Avaka。
paras.en: Glue makes the planks hard to take apart and mend, so a boat turns from something that can be repaired again and again into something used once; people no longer need to tend Avaka for boatbuilding.

paras.zh: 朗島族人說：「連我爸爸的時代都用南寶樹酯了。」
paras.en: An Iraraley community member: "Even in my father's time they already used Nanpao resin."

paras.zh: 不過島上的說法並不一致：有報導人記得 Avaka 做成繩子綁槳架，有人聽過壓縫的做法，也有人沒聽過。手冊在這裡不下結論。
paras.en: On the island, accounts differ: one interviewee remembers Avaka made into cord for oar rests, one has heard of the caulking method, one has not. The handbook draws no conclusion here.

paras.zh: 島上的經濟也在變：從分享飛魚的「人魚網絡」，轉向觀光的貨幣經濟。
paras.en: The island economy is changing too: from a network of sharing flying fish toward a tourist cash economy.

ref.zh: 文本 貳-四、陸-一、陸-三

paras.zh: 研究者原以為 Avaka 不難找，卻屢次聽到它已經消失；有族人把 Nyaga 認作 Avaka，經過多次比對才釐清。
paras.en: The researcher expected Avaka to be easy to find, but heard again and again that it was gone; some took Nyaga for Avaka, and it took many comparisons to sort out.

paras.zh: 目前判斷最有可能是 Avaka 的植株在東清耆老的田區，還沒等到開花結果，物種無法確認。Avaka 的斷裂，已經延伸到植物本身的辨認。
paras.en: The plants judged most likely to be Avaka grow in an Iranmeylek elder's field; they have not yet flowered or fruited, so the species is unconfirmed. The break in Avaka's story now reaches the plant's identity itself.

paras.zh: 朗島族人希望 Avaka「可以被保留，被我們的孩子看到，可以來保護」。
paras.en: An Iraraley community member hopes Avaka "can be kept, seen by our children, and protected".

paras.zh: 本研究以纖維展示盒（三種芭蕉並列，可以摸）、手冊、紀錄片、這個遊戲和課堂，延續它的社會生命。
paras.en: The study carries on its social life through a fibre display box (three banana plants side by side, to touch), a handbook, a documentary, this game and a lesson plan.

lead.zh: 切換「過去／現在」，島上的黃昏市場會移動位置。下面只列文本有出處的對照。
lead.en: Switch between then and now and the evening market moves. Only contrasts with a source in the thesis are listed.

past.en: Set up in the village lanes

now.zh: 移到環島公路兩旁，賣的幾乎都是島外進口的食物
now.en: Moved to both sides of the ring road, selling food almost all brought from off the island

past.zh: 受歲時祭儀規範，禁止買賣
past.en: Governed by the seasonal rites, not to be sold

now.zh: 做成各式加工食品，在市場與餐廳販售
now.en: Made into processed foods sold in markets and restaurants

past.zh: 蘭嶼花椒的纖維塞進船縫，再用 Avaka 纏繞木釘壓實
past.en: Lanyu prickly-ash fibre packed into the seams, pressed down with Avaka wound round wooden pegs

note.zh: 市場在地圖上的位置是示意，不代表實際的攤位。
note.en: The market's position on the map is illustrative, not real stalls.
